description: Hybrid keyword + semantic search over Arca's mirrored public-source corpus, by source type: fda_records (FDA product records: labels and DailyMed, Drugs@FDA approvals and their approval packages (FDA's reviews, pharmacology/toxicology among them, and the administrative and correspondence documents holding FDA's letters and meeting minutes with the applicant), complete response letters (CRLs), Orange Book and Purple Book with their patents, NDC, shortages, FAERS, food, supplement, cosmetic and animal drug adverse events and tobacco problem reports, recalls and enforcement, 510(k)/De Novo/PMA decisions with their summaries, device classification, establishment registrations and device listings, MAUDE, AccessGUDID (UDI), postmarketing requirements, REMS, product-specific guidances, inactive ingredients, CBER biologics, warning and untitled letters, inspections, Form 483s, import refusals and alerts, orphan designations, advisory committee materials, Drug Trials Snapshots, safety communications, debarment lists, AI/ML devices, HDE approvals, substance identifiers (GSRS, UNII), RxNorm, ChEMBL and LOINC (lab and clinical observation codes with their answer lists and panels)); regulatory_guidance (FDA guidance, every other FDA document (guiding principles, joint statements, white papers, frameworks, Q&As), compliance manuals, compounding policy, FDA advisory committee meetings (briefing materials, minutes, transcripts), FDA press announcements, Federal Register notices (FDA, DEA, FTC) and Regulations.gov dockets with their comments, the CFR (21 CFR, HIPAA's 45 CFR, FTC's 16 CFR and other whole titles), CRLs, warning and untitled letters, product-specific guidances, the AI/ML-enabled device list, REMS, FTC cases and business guidance, HHS OCR guidance, US state law (CCHP telehealth policies, state health privacy statutes, California codes, state attorney general actions, pharmacy boards, NAAG, NABP, LegiScan bills), ad platform health policies, NRC Title 10 and ADAMS, and DOE's OSTI medical-isotope catalog); biomedical_literature (PubMed, SciELO, bioRxiv, medRxiv, arXiv and Europe PMC preprints (with open full text), NCBI Bookshelf books with chapter full text (GeneReviews, StatPearls and more), OpenAlex works PubMed does not index, and the reference data papers name: UniProt, PDB, MeSH, WHO ICD-11, Open Targets and drug datasets (OFFSIDES, Drug Repurposing Hub)); clinical_trials (ClinicalTrials.gov (with posted protocols and SAPs, and AACT's day-by-day changes), EU CTIS, EudraCT, and national registries: ISRCTN, Health Canada, OMON, UMIN, jRCT, DRKS, ReBEC, TCTR, PACTR, SLCTR, LBCTR, RPCEC, CRiS, ChiCTR, CTRI, IRCT; plus trial outcome labels from research datasets); public_health (CDC (data catalog, MMWR), ECDC publications, VAERS, CMS (Medicare Part B and D spending and prescribers, national and local coverage determinations and articles, HCPCS and OPPS pass-through codes, Part B drug payment limits (ASP), Medicare hospital payments (inpatient MS-DRG and outpatient APC), Open Payments, NPPES with NUCC taxonomy), Medicaid (NADAC, state drug utilization) and NIH RePORTER grants); clinical_guidelines (clinical practice guidelines and health technology assessments: HAS (France), AHRQ evidence reports, USPSTF recommendations, IQWiG reports, G-BA decisions and § 35a benefit assessment procedures, SMC advice, NCPE (Ireland) drug assessments with their cost-effectiveness findings and NICE guidance (technology appraisals, NICE guidelines, quality standards, interventional procedures, diagnostics and HealthTech) and Cochrane reviews (full text)); standards_quality (ICH guidelines, PIC/S publications and FDA Recognized Consensus Standards); global_regulatory (non-US regulators: EMA (guidelines, medicine documents and EPARs, registers, Q&A, and every other EMA document: reflection and concept papers, guiding principles, presentations, minutes), EU legislation and EudraLex, European Commission health guidance and Union Register decisions, EU MDR/IVDR expert panel opinions, EudraGMDP, MHRA (publications, guidance, granted-licence lists, SmPCs, patient leaflets, public assessment reports and PARD device registrations), Health Canada (DPD, NOC, guidance, review documents, MDALL, recalls, Canada Vigilance), PMDA review reports and Japanese guidance, notices and approval lists, MHLW notices and medicine supply reports (Japanese), MFDS guidance (Korean), NMPA (English site, and archived copies of the Chinese site), CDE guidance and notices (archived copies, Chinese), BfArM, PEI, AEMPS (CIMA), ANSM, French BDPM medicine authorisations, AIFA, CBG-MEB, HSA, Medsafe, HPRA (Ireland safety notices), COFEPRIS (Mexico: alerts, registros sanitarios lists, authorised trials in AARSEC reports, guidance) and the DOF's health NOMs (Normas Oficiales Mexicanas)); device_vigilance (field safety notices, recalls, adverse events and safety alerts for devices: FDA (MAUDE, recalls, enforcement, safety communications), BfArM, PMDA, Health Canada, ANVISA, ANSM and AEMPS); press_releases (company press releases from PR Newswire, Business Wire and GlobeNewswire (PDUFA dates, trial readouts, approvals, deals) and FDA press announcements; searched only when named); company_filings (SEC EDGAR filings, Form D offerings and XBRL company facts; searched only when named); patents (US (USPTO) and European (EPO) patent grants and application publications with claims and description for drug, biologic and device classes, and PTAB trial and appeal decisions; searched only when named; credit European patent data as "This product contains data sourced from EPO databases, © European Patent Organisation"). Read-only lookup of already-published records: it cannot file, submit, or report anything to FDA, VAERS, MedWatch, or any other agency, so do not call it for requests to file or submit a report. When the question names a record type (warning letters, labels, adverse event reports, trials, recalls), pass the matching sourceTypes rather than searching the whole corpus. Results carry recordId for fetch_source_record and a citable source URL.

anyOf.description: Exact metadata facets share a total budget of 50 values across all arrays. Split larger searches into separate requests.

applicationNumbers.description: Exact drug application, device K or PMA numbers, such as NDA209637, K070051 or P900052.

dateField.description: recordDate uses the source's record date: FDA device decision date, label SPL effective date or trial first submission. postedDate stays separate. Choose a trial milestone, lastUpdateDate or inspectionDate explicitly. Partial dates are excluded, never rounded to a day.

decisionCodes.description: FDA device decision codes, such as SESE or APPR.

deviceClasses.description: FDA device classes as upstream strings, such as 1, 2 or 3.

dins.description: Exact Health Canada eight-digit Drug Identification Numbers, preserving leading zeroes.

eventOutcomes.description: Exact outcomes on FDA food, dietary supplement and cosmetic adverse event reports, such as DEATH, HOSPITALIZATION, LIFE THREATENING or VISITED EMERGENCY ROOM, and on FDA animal drug adverse event reports, such as DIED or EUTHANIZED.

inspectionOutcomes.description: FDA inspection classification codes NAI, VAI or OAI.

ndcCodes.description: Exact NDC product codes, preserving leading zeroes and hyphens.

productTypes.description: Upstream product type or category, including FDA import-refusal ProductCategory values such as Foods and CAERS industry names such as COSMETICS or VIT/MIN/PROT/UNCONV DIET(HUMAN/ANIMAL).

reactions.description: Exact reported reactions on FDA food, dietary supplement and cosmetic adverse event reports (MedDRA terms such as NAUSEA or ANAPHYLACTIC REACTION), FDA animal drug adverse event reports (VeDDRA terms such as VOMITING) and FDA tobacco product problem reports (health problems such as COUGHING).

recallClasses.description: Recall classes I, II or III.

recordIds.description: Exact upstream record identifiers, including SPL set/document IDs, trial NCT IDs, device K numbers, PMA supplements such as P900052-S016, PMIDs and substance UNIIs. A trial also lists the PMIDs of its result publications and its EudraCT, CTIS and other registry IDs; a GSRS substance also lists its CAS, DrugBank, ChEMBL and other codes, with numeric ones prefixed by their system, such as RXCUI:1191 or PUBCHEM:2244.

recordTypes.description: 483, EIR, RESPONSE, WARNING LETTER, INSPECTION, IMPORT REFUSAL, RECALL, ADVERSE EVENT, DRUG LABEL, 510(K) or PMA. Other upstream record types retain their names.

publicSourceFilters.description: Exact metadata filters for FDA enforcement, 510(k)/PMA device decisions, drug labels, FDA guidance, ClinicalTrials.gov studies, Health Canada drug records, EudraGMDP, BfArM/PMDA device notices, FDA complete response letters, EU MDR/IVDR expert-panel opinions and FDA food, supplement, cosmetic and animal drug adverse event and tobacco problem reports (filter by reactions, eventOutcomes). Device record date is the decision date, not receipt. Label record date is SPL effective date. Trial record date is first submission, postedDate is first posting; study milestones and lastUpdateDate are separate. Unknown or partial dates do not match ranges.

query.description: Medical, pharma, clinical, regulatory, device, or safety research query.

sourceTypes.description: Optional source lanes to focus the search (see list_datasets). Omit to search the whole corpus.

name: search_medical

continueInArca.description: Link that opens this question in Arca's research chat on arca.inc, which runs a longer multi-step search and writes a fuller cited answer. Offer it to the user once, at the end of the answer.
